detail.title: FEMA Region 6 Watch Control Room Consoles and Furniture
detail.description: The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, Region 6, is issuing a solicitation for the FEMA Region 6 Watch Control Room Consoles and Furniture requirement at the Federal Regional Center located at 800 N. Loop 288, Denton, Texas 76209 . The purpose of this requirement is to refresh the Regional Watch Center furniture and provide furniture suitable for 24/7/365 watch center operations . The requirement includes procurement, delivery, assembly, installation, positioning, and configuration of the following: Eight (8) Steelcase Think Chairs Eight (8) Workstation Chairs One (1) Conference Table Brand-name-or-equal products are permitted. Any proposed equal product must meet or exceed the salient characteristics identified in the SOW and the solicitation. The contractor shall provide all furniture components, hardware, parts, materials, labor, equipment, supervision, and supplies necessary for proper use and full functionality. All products shall be new. Used, reworked, refurbished, or discontinued products are not acceptable. All products shall meet or exceed applicable ANSI/BIFMA performance standards and applicable flame spread/fire rating requirements identified in the solicitation. The contractor shall remove and relocate existing furniture and chairs to the on-campus East Storage Shed in coordination with the Contracting Officer’s Representative. The contractor shall remove all packaging, debris, pallets, wrapping, surplus materials, and waste from the site and shall not use Government waste receptacles or onsite dumpsters. The contractor shall coordinate delivery and installation with the Government. Contractor personnel shall comply with all FEMA facility access, security, conduct, safety, and site-use requirements. Final acceptance will occur after Government inspection confirms all items are installed, functional, and compliant with the solicitation requirements. Vendors shall reference the attached Statement of Work, SOW, for the complete scope of work, technical specifications, delivery, installation, security, and acceptance requirements. detail.title: This effort encompasses all technical, logistical, software and hardware efforts required to produce CCS Meadowlands systems.
detail.description: Purpose: This is a Sources Sought. The Space Systems Command (SSC) located at Los Angeles Air Force Base, California, is seeking information in the form of Statements of Capabilities (SOC) from interested parties in support of the SSC, Space Domain Awareness and Combat Power Directorate requirement for the Counter Communications System (CCS) Meadowlands as described below. The Government is conducting market research to inform its Acquisition Strategy. The purpose of this notice is to identify potential sources that can meet CFC/MD3’s requirement. The Government reserves the right to set this acquisition, or portions thereof, aside for small business – to include socially and economically disadvantaged businesses, 8(a) firms, or woman-owned businesses. The Government is seeking contractors interested in and capable of providing all technical and logistical effort required to design, develop, and deliver capabilities to support the CCS Meadowlands system. Background and Description: Scope: This effort encompasses all technical, logistical, software and hardware efforts required to produce CCS Meadowlands systems. Period and Place of Performance: It is envisioned that the period of performance will be approximately 12 months in duration. The Government is working through the details to determine when the contract will start. The place of performance is flexible to allow contractor to provide an optimized solution. Background: CCS System: CCS is a ground-based counter satellite communications (SATCOM) system specifically designed to reversibly deny, disrupt, and degrade adversarial SATCOM. The basic CCS concept is to provide a flexible, modular, scalable, rapidly deployable system with a key set of signal processing/generation (SP) capabilities, selected counter SATCOM missions, and a robust transmit capability. Its architecture will be designed to host core capabilities and/or other more sophisticated “plug and play” type modules to address the ever-increasing number of technologies and assets available to our adversaries. The latest CCS Meadowlands will have upgraded capabilities compared to the existing CCS 10.2 Systems. The future CCS Meadowlands fleet will be composed of at least 32 systems. Meadowlands is a transportable SATCOM system composed of modular Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) / Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) Radio Frequency (RF) monitoring and generation equipment. The design incorporates multi-band antennas and equipment in transit cases. The frequency conversion system (FCS) that handles RF signals between the shelter transit cases to the antenna uses a proprietary photonics system. The system can be transported by C-130 or larger aircraft and by ground transport over improved or semi-improved roads. The system will be designed for operations by trained operators in US-controlled facilities world-wide, and in the Developmental Support Facility (DSF). The Meadowlands “Base Design” system meets current A-spec requirements​. All systems have same Transit Case and Antenna configuration/capability​. The Meadowlands base design system is comprised of the following major capabilities:​ Three independent, bidirectional antenna polarization paths​ Native Support for a single Large Multiband Antenna (LMA)​ Bands Supported: UHF, L, C, Ku, Ka​ Two separate independently controlled antenna polarization paths​ Simultaneous dual polarization operation​ Receive-only operation if desired​ Supports Base, and unique network specific missions Native Support for a single 1.2m Antenna​ Antenna Supports L-Band only​ The system can operate in three antenna Polarization Paths – Each Polarization Path Contains an Uplink & Downlink RF Interface​. The system is capable of simultaneously operating/controlling up to three antennas and associated components utilizing three polarization paths​. detail.title: RFI-AMSS Integrator
detail.description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: Arctic Mobility Sustainment System Integration IMPORTANT NOTICE The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) notice is to conduct market research to determine the interest, capabilities, and qualifications of potential business or government sources to perform system integration, kitting, packaging, and distribution for the Arctic Mobility Sustainment System (AMSS) . This RFI does not constitute an Invitation for Bid (IFB), a Request for Proposal (RFP), a Request for Quote (RFQ) or an indication that the Government will contract for any of the items and/or services contained in this notice. This is not a request for proposals. No solicitation documents exist at this time. Any information provided does not constitute a proposal but will be considered an exchange of capabilities and ideas. The Government will not be responsible for any costs incurred in furnishing this information or potential participation in the event. This RFI does not constitute a commitment, implied or otherwise, that the Government will take procurement action in this matter. All information received in response to this notice that is marked Proprietary will be handled accordingly. Responses will be reviewed, and businesses of interest will be contacted. Additional information may be requested. The due date for responses is 23 SEP 2026 . BACKGROUND & SCOPE The Arctic Mobility Sustainment System is the successor to the legacy Ahkio system. AMSS addresses the need for equipment to operate effectively in the Arctic environment, where the extreme cold, challenging terrain, and long distances require specialized capabilities. AMSS is being developed as a system that enables dismounted Soldiers to transport sustainment and survivability equipment essential for up to 72 hours. AMSS consists of an Arctic Transport (sled), Arctic Shelter, Arctic Heater, and related Component of End Items (COEI), and will have both a Team (5-man) and a Squad (10-man) configuration. Product Manager Force Sustainment Systems (PdM FSS) is evaluating industry and/or government capabilities to serve as a Lead System Integrator (LSI) to execute procurement, quality control, packaging, kitting, and final delivery of complete systems to designated CONUS and OCONUS end users. SEE ATTACHMENT For Component of End items (COEI) - Squad configuration & KITTING, PACKAGING, AND LOGISTICS STANDARDS Information requested from RESPONDENTS Please submit a white paper addressing the below listed information of interest. The white paper and any pertinent supplemental information must not exceed a combined length of 10 pages . Please structure your response according to the sections below. Do not attach marketing brochures, test reports, or other extraneous materials to your submission, as they will not be reviewed nor will they be considered as part of the evaluation. Electronic copies of responses should be in PDF format using size 12 font with one-inch margins. Following a review of the responses, PdM FSS may request additional information from respondents about their proposed capabilities. **For Arsenals and Depot respondents**: In addition to addressing each section below, please provide overarching acquisition strategy to include: Procurement Contracting Experience and Capability Describe overall integration capabilities, and any relevant experience conducting integration, kitting, and packaging efforts in support of the U.S. Government. For such cases, provide data on production capacity, time needed to ramp up production capacity, and throughput per month. Any available production metrics are welcomed. Provide CAGE code and SAM.gov active registration status. detail.title: Medical Training Command and Control (MT-C2)  Continuation
detail.description: The U.S. Army Program Executive Office for Simulation Training and Instrumentation (PEO STRI) Joint Project Manager for Medical Modeling and Simulation (JPM MMS) Product Manager, Medical Simulation (PdM MedSim) is issuing this Sources Sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify potential sources having an interest and industry technologies available to produce a Medical Training Command and Control (MTC2) System. The MT-C2 System is a control center that will allow remote training platform management within the Army's standardized Medical Simulation Training Centers (MSTC)s. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Based on the responses to this sources sought notice/market research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses (in full or in part) or procured through full and open competition. All small business set-aside categories will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding submissions. DISCLAIMER THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) TO BE SUBMITTED. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. PROGRAM BACKGROUND PdM MedSim has a requirement for the procurement of the production and installation of systems and equipment that provide the capability to command and control all associated equipment that facilitates training within the MSTCs. The MSTC is a standardized Army training Program of Record (POR) located at various military installations worldwide, delivering effective medical training with a standardized training platform to better prepare Soldiers in the application of medical interventions under combat conditions. The MSTC provides medical training and education on new battlefield procedures and equipment, while affording Soldiers the ability to receive comprehensive training in several formats such as the classroom setting, practical hands-on training simulation, trauma lanes, and distance learning. Each MSTC provides a medical skills training platform where Soldiers obtain sustainment and validation of their medical skills in accordance with Training Circular (TC) No. 8-800, Medical Education and Demonstration of Individual Competence (MEDIC), and the Combat Life Saver (CLS) Programs of Instruction (POI). During a training event, Soldiers perform tasks on training devices (manikins and part task trainers) using scalable and adjustable scenarios within the simulated environments. The MT-C2 System enables training environment manipulation, medical scenario integration, mannequin control, audio video (AV) surveillance and recording. The MT-C2 System provides the capability to manipulate the environments in which scenarios take place in order to maximize the positive impact and training experience of each fluid training event within the training experience. The Integration of the MT-C2 System in the MSTCs shall provide equipment standardization across all fielded sites. detail.description: SUBJECT: Sources Sought Notice – Market Research & Technical Capabilities: CAP 097031 RRAD Standby Generator (Project No. 520250) DISCLAIMER: This Sources Sought (SS) is for planning and market research purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or an Invitation for Bids (IFB). This notice is issued under the authority of 10 U.S.C. § 2808a (Other Transaction Authority for Construction and Repair) and is not subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). No solicitation is available at this time. The Government will not pay for any information submitted in response to this notice. 1. Purpose & Project Scope The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Fort Worth District, in support of Red River Army Depot (RRAD), Texarkana, TX, is seeking capabilities statements from qualified firms (both traditional and non-traditional defense contractors) to design and construct a new Standby Generator facility and power backup system (Project No. 520250). The Government is exploring the use of an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under 10 U.S.C. § 2808a to execute this requirement within a fixed Construction Cost Limitation (CCL) / Directed Amount of $5,700,000.00. Key technical requirements of this Unspecified Minor Military Construction Army (UMMCA) project include: - Procurement and installation of a high-capacity standby generator system to support depot operations. - High-voltage electrical utility integration and switchgear upgrades. - Extensive utility coordination with the local power provider (SWEPCO). - Civil site preparation, concrete foundation pads, utility duct banks, and secure physical enclosure construction. - Control system integration and automated transfer scheme logic. 2. Submission Requirements (Capabilities Statement) Interested firms are requested to submit a Capabilities Statement (maximum 5 pages) containing: - Company Information: Name, address, CAGE code, UEI, and confirmation of Non-Traditional Defense Contractor status (per 10 U.S.C. § 3157). - Bonding Capacity: Evidence of a single-project bonding capacity of at least $5,700,000.00 and aggregate of $10,000,000.00. - Relevant Experience: Summaries of up to three.(3) comparable design-build electrical utility or backup generation projects executed within the last five (5) years involving heavy switchgear upgrades, utility coordination (e.g., SWEPCO), or heavy-duty generator installations. 3. Point of Contact & Deadlines - Questions: Submit all clarification questions via email to Jordan L. Kennedy at Jordan.L.Kennedy@usace.army.mil no later than Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at 4:00 PM CDT (21:00 UTC). - Submissions: Submit your capabilities statement via email to Jordan L. Kennedy at Jordan.L.Kennedy@usace.army.mil no later than Monday, September 14, 2026 at 4:00 PM CDT (21:00 UTC). detail.title: Z1DA--556-24-113  Oil Transformer and Switch Enclosure Upgrades
detail.description: CONSTRUCTION STATEMENT OF WORK Date: September 13, 2025 Project Number: 556-24-113 Project Name: Oil Transformer and Switch Enclosure Upgrade (GC) Location: Captain James A. Lovell FHCC 3001 Green Bay Rd, North Chicago, IL 60064 Part 1: Project Scope of Work Overview: Contractor shall provide all tools, materials, labor, quality assurance, and supervision for renovations resulting in a complete, compliant, and fully-functional project. Replace medium voltage oil-filled transformers that serve the following buildings on the James A. Lovell FHCC campus: 1, 3, 9, 11, 66, 137 and 187. Transformers have 4160 volt primary and 208/120 volt secondary. There are (4) transformers rated for 150 KVA, (2) transformers rated for 300 KVA and (1) transformer rated for 750 KVA. The 150 KVA transformer at building 3 will need to be relocated as well. Replace the electrical distribution switchboard at building 137. Replace the electrical distribution switchboard at building 3. Replace concrete pads for medium voltage oil filled transformers at buildings 9, 66, and 187. New transformer location at building 3 requires a new concrete pad as well. Install anti-ram rated bollards at all transformers. Part 2: Period of Performance: The following model presents the summary logic of the milestone sequence working backward from the delivery date of the longest lead time in the critical path to determine a mobilization date, and then forward from the delivery date of the longest lead time to completion of all work. Listed milestones and phases (calendar days): Notice To Proceed Day 0 Division 01 Submissions Completed Day 14 Division 01 VA Reviews Day 35 Division 02+ Submissions Day 50 Division 02+ VA Reviews Day 71 Longest Lead Item Procurement Day 72 (GC to determine and submit) VA review and GC revise schedule Day 93 Mobilize and Demo Day 94 (If all pre-construction submittals were approved) Pre-Longest Lead Item Construction Day 214 (GC to determine) Longest Lead Item Delivery Date Day 215 (GC to determine) Post Long-Lead Item Construction Day 335 (GC to determine) Construction Complete and Closeouts approved Day 356 Closeout (Contract end date) Day 357 Total: 357 days reflects an example workup of the plan. GC must submit the factory ship date commitment to VA and revise the Baseline Schedule to work forward and backward from that date to optimize the time in field (disruption of customer and reduction of GC costs). detail.title: DESC2103C - Bulk Fuel Storage Tanks Phase II, Yokota Air Base, Japan
detail.description: Project Title: DESC2103C - Bulk Fuel Storage Tanks Phase II. Project Description: Construct one 100,000-barrel cut-and-cover JP-8 storage tank. A pump house is to be provided on the top of the tank and contain four 600-gpm issue vertical turbine pumps and one 50-gpm water draw off vertical turbine pump. The new tank will include a high-level valve, independent level alarms, and the hardware necessary for the automatic tank gauging (ATG) system. The new tank includes piping, valves, vaults and appurtenances connecting to an existing filter separator building. The new control system of the new tank will be connected to the existing filter building that houses pump control Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and Human Machine Interface (HMI), automatic tank gauge (ATG) reporting module capable of reporting inputs from all Eastside Fuel Facility tanks. A product saver tank is to be provided for the new bulk storage tank. The Pump House will be of reinforced concrete construction and site adapted to meet local conditions. The roof will be a low slope concrete roof with built-up roofing with overhangs over doorways. The tank is to be steel with concrete outer wall with a rolling cover for access to tank mounted equipment. The product recovery pump will return reclaimed fuel back through receipt filtration to the bulk storage tanks.

detail.title: V--International Expedited Freight Forwarding Service
detail.description: Posted Date: September 8, 2026 Procurement Office: The Department of the Interior (DOI) ¿ Interior Business Center (IBC), Acquisition Services Directorate (AQD) Response Due Date: September 23, 2026, at 1000 AM EST NOTICE OF INTENT SYNOPSIS: The DOI, IBC, AQD on behalf of Peace Corps¿ Office of Operations & Security intends to award three Contracts to Cavalier, EWC, and DBA, on a sole source basis for International Expedited Freight Forwarding Services. These Contracts are anticipated to include a 12-month base period and four 12-month Option Periods. The intended procurement is classified under North American Industry Classification System code (NAICS) Code 488510 ¿ Freight Transportation Arrangement. This is a Sole Source procurement under the authority of Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 12 ¿ Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. There are only three responsible sources, and no other services will satisfy agency requirements. Description of Requirement: The Peace Corps Office of Operations & Security (Facilities Management Division) requires specialized international 4PL freight-forwarding, logistics, and customs-brokerage services for shipments originating from Peace Corps Headquarters to overseas Peace Corps posts in more than 60 countries. This requirement directly supports Volunteer health, safety, and operational infrastructure. Primary shipment categories include: ¿ Temperature-Sensitive Medical Logistics: Pharmaceuticals, vaccines, biological materials, and prescription medications requiring continuous temperature maintenance (+2°C to +8°C, -20°C, and -80°C). ¿ Dangerous Goods: IATA Class 9 hazardous materials, including non-removable lithium-ion batteries installed in IT and medical diagnostic units. ¿ Diplomatic Cargo: Cargo requiring U.S. Department of State (DoS) Government Bills of Lading (GBL) and handoff into diplomatic pouch/cargo chains of custody. Peace Corps operating experience, shipping procedures, and market research to date ¿ including review of vendor corporate history, public regulatory filings, and documented service capabilities ¿ demonstrate that standard commercial parcel services do not provide the combined capability required for this requirement, particularly active cold-chain recovery during transit disruptions, specialized pharmaceutical customs support, and integration with Department of State diplomatic freight processes. Market research and Peace Corps operating experience identify three proposed sources as providing distinct capabilities relevant to the Government's minimum need: Cavalier Logistics, Expedited World Cargo (EWC), and Distribution by Air (DBA)/Radiant Logistics. Therefore, this requirement will be established as three BPAs, one each set up as a sole source to each of these vendors, based on the following rationale: ¿ Common couriers do not offer end-to-end active cold-chain custody, in-transit dry-ice replenishment, or re-icing during flight interruptions or customs holds. In addition, standard commercial couriers generally leave destination customs clearance to the receiving Post. At many Posts, staff do not have the specialized brokerage relationships, pharmaceutical import expertise, or regulatory infrastructure necessary to resolve complex Ministry of Health and customs requirements within the validated cold-chain hold period. Failure to maintain temperature control during transit disruptions results in irreversible product excursion, complete inventory loss, and mission failure through delayed medical treatment for Volunteers. ¿ Cavalier is the only source presently documented as providing this complete logistics model. Under Peace Corps' established cold-chain procedure, the Government maintains the required temperature only through the domestic transfer to Cavalier's Sterling, Virginia operation, after which Cavalier assumes responsibility for maintaining the temperature-controlled environment throughout

detail.title: RFB to Lease the Joshua Brooks House
detail.description: Summary of the Opportunity This Request for Bids (RFB) provides the opportunity for interested individuals and organizations to submit bids to the National Park Service (NPS) to lease NPS property for residential use (single family) at Minute Man National Historical Park under the following general terms and conditions. See attached “Draft Lease” for complete terms of occupancy. Property Offered for Lease Joshua Brooks House The Joshua Brooks House is located at 41 North Great Road, Lincoln, MA 01773. It is approximately 2,216 SF with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It was built by Deacon Joshua Brooks circa 1780 and is situated on an approximately 0.75-acre site. The Joshua Brooks House has been completely renovated with an attached carriage house which could be used for a small car or bikes and kayaks. The first floor is spacious with a redesigned kitchen including new stainless-steel appliances, cabinetry and quartzite counter tops. The newly refinished floors reflect the natural light from meticulously restored windows. The first-floor full bathroom was recently renovated, and a new smart washer and dryer have been installed in the nearby mudroom. Two stairways lead to the second floor where there is a dedicated office, 3 bedrooms, and another recently renovated full bathroom. The house features a restored terraced seating patio overlooking Elm Brook and surrounding forest and active agricultural fields. Uses of the Leased Property This lease is most suitable for low-impact, non-transient, residential occupancy of the house. The lessee is authorized to use the property as an occupant of the house and must be willing to become a part of the National Historical Park’s relationship with the public by maintaining the historic and well-tended appearance of the structure and grounds. In accordance with the attached draft lease, the lessee is responsible for all utilities and routine maintenance. The lessor will perform basic maintenance of the property as described in the lease. Term of Lease The lease will have a maximum term of three years, and a minimum term of one year. Lessee termination rights (termination without cause) will begin 90 days before the end of the first year of the lease and continue until the lease expires. Please note: 90 days’ notice is required for termination without cause. Fair Market Value Rent The lessee will be required by the lease to pay at least fair market value rent to the NPS. Based on the terms included in the attached Lease (Section 5. Rent), the minimum fair market value rent has been determined to be $59,100 annually, payable in equal monthly installments of $4,925 each month. The lessee shall pay to the United States as rent the sum of Fifty-nine Thousand, One-Hundred Dollars ($59,100.00) per year as the base rent payable to the National Park Service and forwarded by the lessee to the Superintendent, Minute Man National Historical Park. Rent checks will be mailed to Minute Man National Historical Park, 174 Liberty Street Concord, MA 01742, attention Superintendent. The annual rent shall be paid on the 1st day of each month in advance monthly installments of Four-Thousand Nine-Hundred and Twenty-five Dollars ($4,925.00). Payment covering the first month will be submitted with the executed lease. Other Terms and Conditions None. Competitive Process This lease opportunity is open to all interested persons on a competitive basis. The bidder submitting a responsive bid offering the highest monthly rent will be selected for award of the lease (subject to a determination of financial capability and reference check). A responsive bid is a bid that meets the material terms and conditions of this request for bids (see attached lease terms). The bid must offer a rental amount that is no less than fair market value as stated above. If two or more bids are equal, a drawing shall make the lease award by lot limited to the equal responsive bids received. Initial and Rolling Bid Submis

detail.description: ***SEE ATTACHED Q&A SET AS OF 03 SEP 2026*** Product Description TELESCOPING MAST PRODUCT DESCRIPTION The FLNG-CDP requires a life cycle replacement for a critical component of the YF309J, Trailer, Special Purpose-the primary telescopic tower utilized by the Air and Marine Reconnaissance Team (AMRT) during reconnaissance and observation (R&O). detail.description: This announcement constitutes a Pre-Solicitation notice (SYNOPSIS) in accordance with FAR Subpart 5.2. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Honolulu District hereby announces its intent to issue a solicitation entitled, ?Relocate Schofield Barracks Deep Wells Above Ground, Building 1580, Schofield Barracks, Oahu, Hawaii? as described within this announcement. This project is a Design-Bid-Build solicitation, utilizing Best Value Trade Off (BVTO) procedures in accordance with FAR Part 15. detail.description: RFQ PCA-ORS-09460 — Replacement of Hanging Cage Systems with Freestanding Animal Housing Racks COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION (i) Description. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products and commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented by the information contained in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. (ii) Solicitation Number. PCA-ORS-09460. This solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). (iii) Provisions and Clauses. The solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through the current Federal Acquisition Circular. (iv) NAICS / PSC / Set-Aside. This acquisition is full and open. The applicable NAICS code is 332999, All Other Miscellaneous Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing . The Product Service Code is 6640, Laboratory Equipment and Supplies . (v) Description of Requirement. The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Research Services, Division of Veterinary Resources (DVR), requires the custom fabrication, delivery, and installation of freestanding animal housing rack systems to replace existing hanging cage infrastructure in Building 103 at the DVR facility in Poolesville, Maryland. The equipment must be custom fabricated for compatibility with DVR's existing cage inventory, facility dimensions, animal care operations, sanitation processes, and drinking-water system. The Government intends to award a single firm-fixed-price contract. (vi) Statement of Work. Objective. The contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, transportation, supervision, and technical expertise necessary to design, fabricate, deliver, install, test, and commission freestanding animal housing rack systems replacing existing hanging cage infrastructure while maintaining animal housing capacity of at least 32 primates under 10 kg per animal per holding room . Cage and Facility Compatibility The rack systems shall: Be compatible with DVR's existing Lab Products/Harford primate hanging cages. Be freestanding and capable of movement through existing animal room, corridor, and cage-wash doors. Accommodate the following approximate cage dimensions and mounting configurations: Single Hanging Cage 28.25 in. D × 35.25 in. H × 24.25 in. W. Two top-rear keyhole cutouts approximately 21 in. apart, center-to-center. One bottom-rear keyhole cutout approximately 12 in. from the side to cutout center. Double Hanging Cage — Model 1 28.25 in. D × 35.25 in. H × 49.25 in. W. Four top-rear keyhole cutouts arranged in two sets approximately 21 in. apart. Two bottom-rear keyhole cutouts approximately 12 in. from each side to cutout center. Double Hanging Cage — Model 2 28.25 in. D × 36.75 in. H × 49.25 in. W. Keyhole configuration consistent with Double Hanging Cage Model 1. Existing Building 103 animal room doors are approximately 81.5–82 in. high × 39.25–39.5 in. wide . The contractor shall verify all applicable doorway, corridor, and cage-wash clearances before final fabrication. Minimum Performance Requirements The rack systems shall: Be constructed of rust- and corrosion-resistant materials suitable for laboratory animal environments. Include an animal drinking-water delivery system with lixits, drain capability, and connections compatible with the existing facility drinking-water system. Include securely supported animal waste collection pans beneath each cage that can be readily removed and handled by DVR staff. Include casters with wheels rated for temperatures of at least 180°F . Withstand routine cage-wash, cleaning, disinfection, and sanitation chemical exposure. Support safe and ergonomic cage handling and reduce the need for elevated or lift-assisted cage transfer. Minimize manual handling during sanitation activities. Minimize pest harborage opportunities. Rem

detail.description: DELIVER TO: Louisiana District Office USDA, APHIS, WS 6129 Egan Hwy. P. O. Box 494 Crowley LA 70531 US This Procurement is for One (1) 16x8 airboat. This boat is needed to access remote marsh locations in South Louisiana. The locations need to be accessed to control Nutria rat and feral swine populations through trapping and opportunistic removal. The marsh locations in question are only accessible via airboat or helicopter. This remote work area requires a boat that is reliable and in most cases the ability to move over dry ground. The saltwater environment requires the boat to be made of aluminum or either stainless steel as all other metals with corrode and rust very quickly. Miscellaneous 1. The boat will then be test run on the water up to 3 hours and brought back in for a second Safety Inspection. After all safety check lists are passed, pictures and video can be provided before shipping. 2. Airboat must be complete in 90 Days or less. 3. detail.title: Implantable Medical-Grade Primary Lithium Batteries
detail.description: Implantable Medical-Grade Primary Lithium Batteries — The contractor shall furnish twenty (20) new and unused implantable medical-grade primary lithium batteries of Li/SVO-CFx chemistry, in two configurations of ten (10) units each. No manufacturer, brand, model, or manufacturer part number is specified. Any product meeting every stated salient characteristic is acceptable. Item 1 — High-rate configuration (Qty 10 EA): Rated capacity 1.70 Ah minimum to 1.90 Ah maximum (nominal 1.78 Ah); OCV-BOL 3.15 V minimum to 3.40 V maximum (nominal 3.25 V); capable of pulse discharge with continuous background load ≥95.3 kΩ, pulse amplitude ≥3.0 A, pulse duration 10 seconds, pulse frequency up to once every 150 days, and 2.0 V cutoff. Stainless steel case; negative case polarity; molybdenum or equivalent terminal; hermetically sealed; weight ≤17 g; volume ≤6.5 cc; approximate dimensions 34.93 mm × 27.94 mm × 6.30 mm and shall not exceed these values by more than 5%; storage temperature –20°C to +60°C. All 10 units shall be from the same manufacturing lot. Item 2 — Medium-rate configuration (Qty 10 EA): Rated capacity 4.80 Ah minimum to 5.00 Ah maximum (nominal 4.92 Ah); OCV-BOL 3.15 V minimum to 3.40 V maximum (nominal 3.25 V); capable of medium-rate sustained discharge with pulsing, background load 9.53 kΩ, pulse amplitude 20 mA, pulse duration 900 seconds, pulse frequency up to once every 63 days, cutoff voltage 2.0 V minimum, with usable capacity 4.80 Ah to 5.00 Ah between OCV-BOL and cutoff at 37°C. Titanium case; negative case polarity; titanium or equivalent terminal; hermetically sealed; weight ≤22 g; volume ≤12.5 cc; approximate dimensions 46.48 mm × 31.70 mm × 9.63 mm and shall not exceed these values by more than 5%; operating temperature 37°C nominal; storage temperature –20°C to +60°C. All 10 units shall be from the same manufacturing lot. For both configurations, each battery shall have a minimum of two (2) years remaining from the date of manufacture at delivery. Product documentation shall include battery specifications, safety data sheets (SDS), and other applicable product documentation at no separate charge. Packaging shall follow standard commercial practice and applicable safety and transportation regulations for lithium-based medical-grade components, including applicable DOT and IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations. Lot number and date of manufacture shall be marked on each package. Advance shipping notification shall include carrier, tracking information, and estimated delivery date, and delivery logistics shall be coordinated with the Government POC before shipment. The Government will accept the contractor's standard commercial warranty to the maximum extent practicable. The batteries are passive supply items with no embedded or companion software, no FDA network connection, and no storage or transmission of data. Requirements document is in the solicitation.

detail.title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu, HI
detail.description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the water (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison -Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu, Hawaii. USAG-HI is considering the potential privatization of the water utility systems serving Schofield Barracks – Main Post, Wheeler Army Airfield, Schofield Barracks – East Range, Pililaau Army Recreation Center, Fort Shafter, Tripler Army Medical Center, Fort DeRussy, Helemano Military Reservation, Kahuku Training Area, Aliamanu Military Reservation, Makua Valley Training Area, Coast Guard Housing, Field Station Kunia, Dillingham Military Reservation, and Lightning Academy. The USAG-HI water utility systems to be privatized under this solicitation may include the housing portions of the water utility systems. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. §2688 – Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor will be selected to assume ownership of the water utility system. The new owner shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner’s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. detail.title: Installation of Commercial Gate - Houlton, Maine
detail.description: Department of Homeland Security determined the need for an Inbound gate to be installed at the Land Port of Entry located at Houlton Maine. This gate shall be a double arm gate that is 24 feet wide, with a heated operation system to withstand the harsh temperatures of Houlton Maine. The following features need to be included: Traffic light mounted per design and wired in sequence with the gate operations, light up gate arms (green up, red down), safety closer sensor, and gate must have upright lock capabilities. This gate will need to be hard wired to the panel that is on backup power. The gate operation mechanism will need to be a hard wire switch to the CBP officer booth within arm’s reach of the booth window.

detail.title: Blanket Purchase Agreement - Sample Testing
detail.description: The requirement is for the establishment of single Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA) for the testing of metal coupons to aid the QA process of the components with which these coupons are associated . The Contractor’s laboratory facility must be validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) along with maintain ISO/IEC 17025 certification and remain validated throughout the life of this agreement. Project Background The Contractor shall receive, test mechanical and/or chemical characteristics, and submit reports of coupon materials to aid the QA process of the associated components supplied to the Government via other ongoing contract efforts. The coupons will be shipped directly to the Contractor, many of which will likely come from international locations. The Contractor will not be responsible for shipping or duty costs to receive coupons. The coupon materials that may be tested include but may not be limited to ASTM A743 Grade CA6NM and Grade CF3, ASTM A27 Grade 70-40, ASTM A148 Grade 80-40, ASTM A216 Grade WCC, and ASTM A516 Grade 60. The tests that may be required include chemical analysis according to ASTM A751, carbon combustion according to ASTM E1019-18, tensile tests (yield strength, tensile strength, elongation, and reduction of area) according to ASTM A370, hardness tests according to ASTM A370, and Charpy v-notch impact tests according to ASTM A370. The range of tests completed for a given coupon will depend on the material and component with which it is associated. There may be provisions for optional storage of coupons, both tested and untested. Disposal of excess coupons may be considered at no additional cost to the Government.
